content:
lina: dropping a quick ask - prototype for a compact heatmap in the console that ties token-unit cost to routing policy & quota state. rows= model_sku, cols= routing_policy (low-latency | cost-saver | fallback). cell shows unit cost, cache-savings credited, and a small tag if quota-throttled. figma: https://figma.redwood.local/routing-cost-heatmap (WIP)

oscar: nice. important Q: if a route gets quota-throttled and falls back to a cheaper model, how do we reflect that in per-route unit cost? we don't want to hide fallback-induced cost shifts.

priya: proposal: heatmap reads daily rollups keyed by (tenant, route_id, model_sku, routing_policy, day). rollup fields: tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_apportioned_bucket, quota_throttle_count, fallback_count. UI can show 'net unit cost' and a split view: with-fallbacks / without-fallbacks.

mike: telemetry caution: adding route_id and routing_policy increases cardinality. route_id is high-cardinality. Suggest hashing route_id into coarse buckets (route_bucket=0..999) for the UI, and provide drilldown only when the owner requests a detailed export.

priya: agree on bucketing. For producer SDK change: emit minimal flags: `route_bucket`, `routing_policy_enum` (latency|cost|fallback), `quota_status_enum` (ok|throttled), `cache_credit_enum` (0|.01|.05|.1|.25|.5|1). keep sample rate for raw traces at 1%.

mike: also, quantize `cache_credit_enum` and `route_bucket` on the client side to avoid ingest churn. server-side rollup will sum counts per bucket.

infra-bot: snapshot: model=gptx-8b day=2026-04-01 tokens=3,212,000 cache_hits=112,200 route_bucket=42 routing_policy=cost-saver quota_throttles=12 fallback_count=9

billing-bot: sample calc: tenant=beta-co model=gptx-8b day=2026-04-01 raw_cost=$4,321 apportioned_cache_savings=$412 net=$3,909 (heatmap rollup) :dollar:

oscar: UX thought: have a small filter for 'exclude fallback' so product folks can see the intrinsic model cost vs what routing adjustments did. also show a tiny line explaining 'route_bucket is a sampled aggregation to protect cardinality' so customers aren't confused.

lina: rollout plan: behind feature-flag `routing-cost-heatmap`. start with 5% orgs for 2 weeks. Metrics to watch: `telemetry.rollup.error_rate`, `heatmap.query.p95_latency`, `ingest.unique_route_buckets_per_day`. abort conditions: rollup_error_rate > 0.5% for 24h or unique_route_buckets > 10k/day.

priya: infra tasks: add a daily idempotent rollup job (sharded) with optional hourly derived stream for near-RT preview. add backfill script for last-30d. add migration doc for Private deployments (they must enable ingest.schema=v3 to opt-in).

mike: ops guardrails: if any single tenant produces >5k unique route_ids/day, cap to `route_bucket=other` and emit an alert so SRE can follow up. prevents noisy customers from burning cardinality.

infra-bot: created checklist: [producer-sdk bump with enums] [rollup job + backfill] [route_bucket guardrail] [feature-flag gating] [Grafana panels: heatmap.query.p95, telemetry.rollup.lag, ingest.unique_route_buckets]

billing-bot: sample delta: tenant=beta-co day=2026-03-31 raw_cost=$3,980 apportioned_savings=$390 net=$3,590

oscar: owners: priya -> producer + rollup infra, mike -> cardinality & alerts, lina -> UX + rollout flag, oscar -> Grafana + runbook. I'll own the abort watch during the 5% rollout.

priya: I'll open PRs: 1) producer SDK + quantization guide 2) rollup job + k8s job template 3) backfill helper + migration docs for Private. target: land producer PR by next Tue, start feature-flag rollout Wed.

lina: I'll add the heatmap panel prototype to the console repo behind the flag. small tooltip: 'How are savings calculated' links to rollup provenance and sample invocation traces (sampled).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: priya/route-cost-rollups -> staging at 1745559995 :rocket:

billing-bot: quick note: we should include a CSV export per-cell with breakdown (tokens, cache_credited, fallback_count) for finance reconciliation.

mike: agreed. export will be generated from rollup aggregates to avoid hitting raw events. include the `route_bucket` mapping table when available.

lina: thanks team  no objections, we'll proceed. sync on Thursday to review the first staging rollups.
